## Overview

Make MLA DCP query gather, A2A reduction and KV gather replaceable through `CustomOp`.

## Claims

- The custom ops own computation and fallbacks; workspaces hold buffers/views.
- Preserve CUDA/ROCm/XPU dispatch, `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_*` controls and existing GPU kernels/fallbacks.

## Validation

243 CPU tests and scoped hooks passed. Prior GPU validation/benchmarks at `3c7baf6`: 196 four-B200 tests and compiled OOT checks passed; identical collective kernels/counts and all 115,200 paired token IDs. This fix leaves CUDA/ROCm execution unchanged. XPU/TPU/OOT hardware was not tested.

Same four B200s; two-layer dummy-weight DeepSeek-V2-Lite, BF16 TP4/DCP4, CUDA graphs. Three paired runs × 15 timed batches after warmup; prefill + 64-token generation. Median ms (range of run medians):

| Path / batch / prompt | Main | PR | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Direct / 4 / 32 | 96.3 (95.7–96.9) | 96.0 (94.8–97.8) | -0.4% |
| Direct / 16 / 256 | 167.2 (166.9–171.8) | 166.2 (163.7–170.2) | -0.6% |
| Fallback / 4 / 32 | 100.6 (92.6–108.5) | 102.3 (98.4–114.7) | +1.7% |
| Fallback / 16 / 256 | 180.7 (172.1–184.1) | 186.2 (175.5–188.9) | +3.0% |

Batch 16 logprobs match exactly. Batch 4 varies by up to 0.00195, also observed within unmodified main. Fallback batch 16 is 2–3% slower across pairs; unchanged kernels do not establish zero wrapper overhead. [Results and reproduction](https://gist.github.com/andylolu2/1d9d564e623bb444d7d06da5b2549193).

<details>
<summary>Test commands</summary>

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/distributed/test_dcp_direct_a2a_lse_reduce.py tests/distributed/test_dcp_a2a.py tests/model_executor/test_enabled_custom_ops.py -q -k 'not distributed_direct and (test_dcp_direct or test_direct_dcp or TestLSEWeightedCombine or test_enabled_ops or test_oot_collective_dispatch)'
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/distributed/test_dcp_direct_a2a_lse_reduce.py -q -s
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files vllm/model_executor/custom_op.py vllm/v1/attention/ops/cp_common.py vllm/v1/attention/ops/dcp.py tests/distributed/test_dcp_direct_a2a_lse_reduce.py docs/design/custom_op.md .buildkite/test_areas/distributed.yaml tools/pre_commit/test_tethering_allowlist.txt
```

</details>

## Details

CUDA/ROCm/XPU retain existing paths under Inductor's global `none`; explicit per-op disable selects Torch. CPU/TPU/OOT inherit native dispatch, avoiding GPU-only kernels and CUDA-only plugin overrides.

Related: [#60218](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60218), [#60606](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60606), [#50009](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50009), [#61922](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61922); none provides generic collective overrides.

+
+### Direct DCP Collectives
+
+`DirectDCPQGather`, `DirectDCPA2AReduce` and `DirectDCPKVGather` in
+`vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp` support OOT replacements. Workspaces own buffers and
+views; ops own communication, reduction and fallbacks. `workspace` may be `None`.
+CUDA preserves the existing direct kernels, eligibility controls and fallbacks;
+XPU retains its existing fallbacks. CPU, TPU and OOT default to Torch
+`forward_native`.
+
+Register through `vllm.general_plugins` on every worker before model construction.
+Override `forward_cuda`; handle absent/oversized workspaces or call `super()`:
+
+```python
+import torch
+
+from my_plugin.kernels import gather_query
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import DirectDCPQGather
+
+
+@DirectDCPQGather.register_oot
+class PluginDCPQGather(DirectDCPQGather):
+    def forward_cuda(self, local_query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return gather_query(local_query, self.group, self.workspace)
+```
+
+Eligible direct kernels stay enabled, including with Inductor and `["none"]`.
+Use `["-direct_dcp_q_gather"]` to select Torch for an in-tree op, or
+`["-DirectDCPQGather"]` for its OOT replacement. `VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_*` continues
+to control direct workspace allocation with its existing semantics.
+
+Preserve output layouts, both LSE bases, empty-shard handling and workspace
+synchronization/epochs. All ranks must use the same plugin/config and collective
+order. Keep buffers and bindings stable through CUDA graph replay.
